summary: Game crashes when player model is rendered after the player is stung by a bee
description: The bug When getting stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. To reproduce There are multiple ways to reproduce this issue: Inventory - Get stung by a bee - Open your inventory Third-person camera - Enable third-person camera - Get stung by a bee Crash report 19w39a : [^crash-2019-09-27_13.19.08-client.txt] Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex at cxk.a(SourceFile:253) at dwx.a(SourceFile:56) at dyd.a(SourceFile:48) at dyd.a(SourceFile:14) at duw.a(SourceFile:138) at dym.a(SourceFile:64) at dym.a(SourceFile:41) at dtz.a(SourceFile:268) at dtz.a(SourceFile:253) at dgt.a(SourceFile:134) at dgt.a(SourceFile:106) at dfx.render(SourceFile:82) at dgm.render(SourceFile:42) at dgt.render(SourceFile:86) at dpo.a(SourceFile:603) at dat.d(SourceFile:931) at dat.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enable the third-person camera.
4. Get stung by a bee.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered.
Observed Behavior: When a player is stung by a bee, the game experiences a crash upon rendering the player model. This issue can be replicated in two main scenarios: first, by getting stung by a bee and then attempting to open the inventory, and second, by enabling the third-person camera mode, getting stung, and then observing the crash. The crash report generated during this event indicates a java.lang.IllegalStateException due to not filling all elements of the vertex, which occurs at various points in the rendering process as detailed in the stack trace. The crash report specifically references source files related to rendering entities in the world, highlighting a failure in the rendering pipeline that leads to the game halt. This bug is critical as it disrupts gameplay and may lead to data loss if players are unable to save their progress before the crash occurs.
Expected Behavior: When a player gets stung by a bee, the game should continue to function normally without crashing. Upon getting stung, the player model should render correctly in both the inventory and third-person camera views, allowing the player to interact with the game seamlessly. There should be no errors or exceptions thrown during this process, ensuring a stable gameplay experience.
